purpose: Flag likely Standard Estonian morphological leakage in intended Tartu dialect text while preserving Tartu features (no written q glottal stop, endingless/-s 3sg, -va/-se 3pl, -de/-he illative, -ss/-st/-s translative, epenthetic üits/kaits).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian active past participle -nud. Tartu uses -nu/-nü (olnu, tennü), without final -d.
rules.hint: Rewrite active past participle with Tartu -nu/-nü.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian passive past participle -tud/-dud. Tartu uses -t/-d or -tu/-tü/-du/-dü.
rules.hint: Rewrite with Tartu passive past morphology (-t/-d/-tu/-tü/-du/-dü).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian past negation ei + -nud/-tud. Tartu past negation uses es + verb (es ole, es tii).
Standard Estonian pole/polnud/poleks/polevat is Estonian leakage in Tartu dialect.
rules.hint: Use Tartu ei ole / es ole / ei oless.

rules.message: May be Standard Estonian 3sg present -b. Traditional Tartu 3sg present is endingless or -s (eläs, kõneles, tulõ).
rules.hint: Check whether Tartu expects an endingless or -s verb form.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian 3pl present -vad. Tartu 3pl present uses -va/-vä or -se/-sõ.
Looks like Standard Estonian impersonal -takse/-dakse. Tartu uses -tas/-täs/-das/-däs.
Looks like Standard Estonian conditional -ksin/-ksime/-ksite. Tartu conditional uses -ss/-ssi.
Looks like Standard Estonian illative -sse. Tartu uses -de/-he or short/geminate illative.
rules.hint: Replace Estonian -sse with Tartu illative (-de/-he or short form).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural illative -desse/-tesse.
rules.hint: Use Tartu plural illative (-de/-he or stem form).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural partitive -sid. Tartu normally uses -it/-id, vowel plural, or -sit.
Looks like Estonian -mas supine. Tartu supine inessive is -man/-män.
Looks like Estonian -mata abessive. Tartu uses -malda/-mäldä (or -mada).
May be Estonian translative -ks. Tartu translative uses -st, -ss, or -s.
Check whether Standard Estonian lexical item leaked into Tartu (where üits, kaits, nüid, väiga, pallu, midägi are common).
rules.hint: Check authentic Tartu lexical/epenthetic forms (üits, kaits, midägi).

do_not_flag_suffixes.reason: Tartu does not mark glottal stop q in orthography, so infinitives/plurals naturally lack -q.
Tartu translative can end in -st or -ss.
